title: Small Plane Carrying Florida Family Missing Off Bahamas
meta_title: Florida Family's Plane Missing Off Bahamas; Search Suspended
meta_description: A small plane carrying four members of a Florida family went missing off the Bahamas on Monday. Search efforts by the U.S. Coast Guard and Bahamian...
discover_titles: Florida Family of Four Vanishes in Plane Off Bahamas
Bad Weather Halts Search for Missing Plane Carrying Florida Family
Urgent Search Underway for Missing Plane Near Bahamas
spot: A small plane carrying four members of a Florida family went missing off the Bahamas on Monday while flying back home. The U.S. Coast Guard and Bahamian authorities launched a search operation, but efforts were suspended due to adverse weather conditions. The family on board included an 80-year-old pilot, his 79-year-old wife, and their two grandchildren.
content_html:
Key Developments

  • A small PA-34 Piper five-seater aircraft, tail number N212ML, carrying four members of a Florida family, went missing off the Bahamas on Monday.
  • The plane departed from Great Harbour Cay in the Berry Islands, Bahamas, and was en route to Miami Executive Airport in Miami-Dade County, Florida.
  • Air traffic control lost contact with the aircraft when it was approximately 13 miles west of Andros Island. Bahamian police believe the plane may have crash-landed off the coast of Red Bays, North Andros.
  • The family members on board have been identified as pilot Mario Lamar, 80, his wife Lili Lamar, 79, and their grandchildren Sofia Sosa, 28, and Christian Sosa, 22.
  • Bahamian officials contacted the U.S. Coast Guard for assistance, leading to the launch of an HC-144 Ocean Sentry to aid in search-and-rescue efforts.
  • However, the search operation had to be suspended due to severe weather conditions, and it is currently unclear when it will resume.
  • A family member, Silvia Larrieu, niece of Mario and Lili Lamar, issued a public plea for help with search-and-rescue efforts, emphasizing the urgency to bring them home.

Key Takeaways

  • A small plane carrying four Florida family members is missing after departing the Bahamas for Miami.
  • The U.S. Coast Guard and Bahamian authorities initiated a search, focusing on the area west of Andros Island.
  • Search-and-rescue operations have been temporarily halted due to challenging weather conditions.

Why It Matters

The disappearance of a private aircraft carrying an entire family highlights the inherent risks associated with small plane travel, particularly over open water. This incident underscores the critical role of international cooperation between agencies like the U.S. Coast Guard and Bahamian authorities in coordinating extensive search and rescue operations. The suspension of the search due to weather also emphasizes the significant challenges faced by rescuers in adverse conditions, leaving the family and community in a distressing state of uncertainty.
